items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Me and I, I tell you, brought him out on the first job. Uh, he's a good musician too.

ctx.x: We asked him about bass players, some of the good bass players.
He said, how about some of the good bass players? Well, George Fulston, he was good. Eddie Scott, Lil Chester. Yeah, what called Lil Chester? He's down there, yep. I see them, but...
